Paragraph: "Here they come wearing jute cloths and move about in this impassable forest deceitfully, definitely Vali must have dispatched them..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Cognitive distortion leading to paranoia; assuming strangers are covert assassins sent by an enemy.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva leaps to conclusions based on past persecution by his brother Vali.
Outcome/Resolution: He misinterprets ascetic clothing as a deceitful disguise for an attack.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Moha (Delusion/misconception obscuring true reality due to past fear)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Preconditioned fear causes the soul to mistake divine saviors for hostile adversaries sent to destroy it.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Paranoid projection: past trauma from an abusive figure (Vali) causes neutral or benign ambiguous stimuli to be interpreted as targeted threats.
